decided: The first candidate is the stem itself; numbering starts at 2 with no separator (`ada2`), as `suggest` does today.
The stem is cut to make room for the number; the number is never cut.
A cut keeps a trailing hyphen or underscore (it is still a valid handle).
A variant equal to an earlier candidate is skipped and numbering continues; skipped numbers are not reused.
The stem must pass `checkHandle` as given; it is not cleaned or lowercased. Errors for the stem say "stem".
The count must be an integer from 1 to 100; other counts throw a RangeError that says "count".
Seam (the files the stub writes): packages/core/src/handle.ts
Allowed paths (what the implementer may change): packages/core/src/handle.ts
